name: command-screen-of-a-discobox-it-created
why: A lead reads its own worker's screen under a policy bounded to the discoboxes it created, read against the facts about the discobox the command names: the lead created it (ADR 26-10-14-320 §5; issue #335).

job.purpose: look after the discoboxes this discobox created: read their records and their terminals' screens

statements: allow read on discobox created by $this in project "default"
allow read on terminal within discobox created by $this in project "default"

definitions.discobox: A Discobox sandbox: its record in the discobox API, /projects/<project>/sandboxes/<id>, which is what reading one returns.
definitions.project: A Discobox project, by its name; the API names it in its paths, /projects/<name>/.
definitions.terminal: One of a discobox's terminals, by its name (primary is the one its harness runs in): what it shows, read with discobox admin terminal screen.
